{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_clean'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
completed_clean = completed[~qa_mask]

# Compute and print the number of completed orders and the mean revenue
n_completed = len(completed)
n_completed_clean = len(completed_clean)
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Number of completed orders: {n_completed}")
print(f"Number of completed orders after excluding QA: {n_completed_clean}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
